A reservoir returns

The Willow reservoir reopened on Tuesday, after crews repaired the inlet, cleared the channel and tested the spillway. Residents walked along the restored footpath while volunteers recorded the first water readings for the autumn survey.

Water checks

The local team published its water report for residents. It describes the sampling method, explains the repaired gate and lists the next inspection dates. The footpath will stay open while crews monitor the banks.
